4.madueke_b: and he commanded them, saying: Thus speak ye unto my lord Esau: This saith thy brother Jacob: I have sojourned, and have been with Laban until this present day.

5.s_dismas: I haue oxen, and aſſes, and ſheepe, and men ſeruants, and wemen ſeruants: and now I ſend a legacie to my lord, that I may finde grace in thy ſight.
5.odr_com: I haue oxen, and asses, and sheepe, and men seruants, and wemen seruants: and now I send a leagacie to my lord, that I may finde grace in thy sight.
5.sabates_a: I have oxen, & asses, & sheep, & men servants: & women servants: & now I send a legacy to my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
5.madueke_b: I have oxen, & asses, & sheep, & men servants: & women servants: & now I send a legacy to my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

6.s_dismas: And the meſſengers returned to Iacob, ſaying: We came to Eſau thy brother, and behold he cometh with ſpede to mete thee with foure hundred men.
6.odr_com: And the messengers returned to Iacob, saying: We came to Esau thy brother, and behold he cometh with spede to mete thee with foure hundred men.
6.sabates_a: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying: We came to Esau thy brother, & behold he cometh with speed to meet thee with four hundred men.
6.madueke_b: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying: We came to Esau thy brother, & behold he cometh with speed to meet thee with four hundred men.

7.s_dismas: Iacob feared exceedingly: & being ſore affraid diuided the people that was with him, the flockes alſo and the ſhepe and the oxen, and the camels, into two troupes,
7.odr_com: Iacob feared exceedingly: & being sore affraid diuided the people that was with him, the flockes also and the shepe and the oxen, and the camels, into two troupes,
7.sabates_a: Jacob feared exceedingly: and being sore afraid divided the people that was with him, the flocks also and the sheep, and the oxen, and the camels, into two troops,
7.madueke_b: Jacob feared exceedingly: and being sore afraid divided the people that was with him, the flocks also and the sheep, and the oxen, and the camels, into two troops,

8.s_dismas: ſaying: If Eſau come to one troupe, and ſtrike it, the other troupe that remaineth, ſhal be ſaued.
8.odr_com: saying: If Esau come to one troupe, and strike it, the other troupe that remaineth, shal be saued.
8.sabates_a: saying: If Esau come to one troop, and strike it, the other troop that remaineth shall be saved.
8.madueke_b: saying: If Esau come to one troop, and strike it, the other troop that remaineth shall be saved.

9.s_dismas: And Iacob ſaid: O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Iſaac: O Lord that dideſt ſay to me: Returne into thy land, and into the place of thy natiuitie, and I wil doe thee good.
9.odr_com: And Iacob said: O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac: O Lord that didest say to me: Returne into thy land, and into the place of thy natiuitie, and I wil doe thee good.
9.sabates_a: And Jacob said: O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac; O Lord that didst say to me: Return into thy land, and into the place of thy nativity, and I will do thee good:
9.madueke_b: And Jacob said: O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac; O Lord that didst say to me: Return into thy land, and into the place of thy nativity, and I will do thee good:

10.s_dismas: I am inferiour to al thy mercies, and thy truth that thou haſt fulfilled to thy ſeruant. With my ſtaffe I paſſed ouer this Iordain: and now with two troupes I doe returne.
10.odr_com: I am inferiour to al thy mercies, and thy truth that thou hast fulfilled to thy seruant. With my staffe I passed ouer this Iordain: and now with two troupes I doe returne.
10.sabates_a: I am inferior to all thy mercies, and thy truth that thou hast fulfilled to thy servant. With my staff I passed over this Jordan: and now with two troops I do return.
10.madueke_b: I am inferior to all thy mercies, and thy truth that thou hast fulfilled to thy servant. With my staff I passed over this Jordan: and now with two troops I do return.

11.s_dismas: Deliuer me from the hand of my brother Eſau, becauſe I am ſore affraid of him: leſt perhaps he come, and ſtrike the mother with the children.
11.odr_com: Deliuer me from the hand of my brother Esau, because I am sore affraid of him: lest perhaps he come, and strike the mother with the children.
11.sabates_a: Deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, because I am sore afraid of him: lest perhaps he come, and strike the mother with the children.
11.madueke_b: Deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, because I am sore afraid of him: lest perhaps he come, and strike the mother with the children.

12.s_dismas: Thou dideſt ſay that thou wouldeſt do good to me, and dilate my ſeed as the ſand of the ſea, which for multitude can not be numbred.
12.odr_com: Thou didest say that thou wouldest do good to me, and dilate my seed as the sand of the sea, which for multitude can not be numbred.
12.sabates_a: Thou didst say that thou wouldst do good to me, and dilate my seed as the sand of the sea, which for multitude cannot be numbered.
12.madueke_b: Thou didst say that thou wouldst do good to me, and dilate my seed as the sand of the sea, which for multitude cannot be numbered.

13.s_dismas: And when he had ſlept there that night, he ſeparated of thoſe things which he had, giftes to his brother Eſau,
13.odr_com: And when he had slept there that night, he separated of those things which he had, giftes to his brother Esau,
13.sabates_a: And when he had slept there that night, he separated of those things which he had, gifts to his brother Esau,
13.madueke_b: And when he had slept there that night, he separated of those things which he had, gifts to his brother Esau,

14.s_dismas: ſhe goates two hundred, he goates twentie, ewes two hundred, and rammes twentie,
14.odr_com: she goates two hundred, he goates twentie, ewes two hundred, and rammes twentie,
14.sabates_a: she goats two hundred, he goats twenty, ewes two hundred, and rams twenty,
14.madueke_b: she goats two hundred, he goats twenty, ewes two hundred, and rams twenty,

15.s_dismas: thirtie milch camels with their coltes, fourtie kine, and twentie bulles, twentie ſhe aſſes, and their foles ten.
15.odr_com: thirtie milch camels with their coltes, fourtie kine, and twentie bulles, twentie she asses, and their foles ten.
15.sabates_a: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and twenty bulls, twenty she asses, and their foals ten.
15.madueke_b: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and twenty bulls, twenty she asses, and their foals ten.

16.s_dismas: And he ſent by the handes of his ſeruants, euerie flocke by it ſelfe, and he ſaid to his ſeruants: Goe before me, and let there be a ſpace betwen flocke and flocke.
16.odr_com: And he sent by the handes of his seruants, euerie flocke by it selfe, and he said to his seruants: Goe before me, and let there be a space betwen flocke and flocke.
16.sabates_a: And he sent by the hands of his servants every flock by it-self, and he said to his servants: Go before me, and let there be a space between flock and flock.
16.madueke_b: And he sent by the hands of his servants every flock by it-self, and he said to his servants: Go before me, and let there be a space between flock and flock.

17.s_dismas: And he commanded the former, ſaying: If thou mete my brother Eſau, and he aske thee, whoſe art thou? or whither goeſt thou? or whoſe are theſe that thou doeſt folowe?
17.odr_com: And he commanded the former, saying: If thou mete my brother Esau, and he aske thee, whose art thou? or whither goest thou? or whose are these that thou doest folowe?
17.sabates_a: And he commanded the former, saying: If thou meet my brother Esau, and he ask thee, whose art thou? Or whither goest thou? Or whose are these that thou doest follow?
17.madueke_b: And he commanded the former, saying: If thou meet my brother Esau, and he ask thee, whose art thou? Or whither goest thou? Or whose are these that thou doest follow?

18.s_dismas: thou ſhalt anſwere: Iacobes thy ſeruant, he hath ſent them for gifts to my lord Eſau: himſelfe alſo cometh after vs.
18.odr_com: thou shalt answere: Iacobes thy seruant, he hath sent them for gifts to my lord Esau: himselfe also cometh after vs.
18.sabates_a: Thou shalt answer: Jacob's thy servant, he hath sent them for gifts to my lord Esau: himself also cometh after us.
18.madueke_b: Thou shalt answer: Jacob's thy servant, he hath sent them for gifts to my lord Esau: himself also cometh after us.

19.s_dismas: In like maner he gaue commandements to the ſecond, and the third, and to al that folowed the flocks, ſaying: With the ſelfe ſame words ſpeake ye to Eſau, when you ſhal finde him.
19.odr_com: In like maner he gaue commandements to the second, and the third, and to al that folowed the flocks, saying: With the selfe same words speake ye to Esau, when you shal finde him.
19.sabates_a: In like manner he gave commandments to the second, and the third, and to all that followed the flocks, saying: With the self-same words speak ye to Esau, when you shall find him.
19.madueke_b: In like manner he gave commandments to the second, and the third, and to all that followed the flocks, saying: With the self-same words speak ye to Esau, when you shall find him.

20.s_dismas: And ye ſhal adde: Iacob alſo thy ſeruant himſelfe foloweth on after vs; for he ſaid: I wil pacifie him with the gifts that goe before, and afterward I wil ſee him, perhaps he wil be gracious vnto me.
20.odr_com: And ye shal adde: Iacob also thy seruant himselfe foloweth on after vs; for he said: I wil pacifie him with the gifts that goe before, and afterward I wil see him, perhaps he wil be gracious vnto me.
20.sabates_a: And ye shall add: Jacob also thy servant himself followeth on after us; for he said: I will pacify him with the gifts that go before, and afterward I will see him, perhaps he will be gracious unto me.
20.madueke_b: And ye shall add: Jacob also thy servant himself followeth on after us; for he said: I will pacify him with the gifts that go before, and afterward I will see him, perhaps he will be gracious unto me.

21.s_dismas: The giftes therfore went before him, but himſelfe lodged that night in the campe.
21.odr_com: The giftes therfore went before him, but himselfe lodged that night in the campe.
21.sabates_a: The gifts therefore went before him, but himself lodged that night in the camp.
21.madueke_b: The gifts therefore went before him, but himself lodged that night in the camp.

22.s_dismas: And when he was riſen early he tooke his two wiues, and his hand-maides as manie, with his eleuen ſonnes, and paſſed ouer the ford Iaboc.
22.odr_com: And when he was risen early he tooke his two wiues, and his handmaides as manie, with his eleuen sonnes, and passed ouer the ford Iaboc.
22.sabates_a: And when he was risen early, he took his two wives, and his handmaids as many, with his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Iaboc.
22.madueke_b: And when he was risen early, he took his two wives, and his handmaids as many, with his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Iaboc.

23.s_dismas: And when he had ſet ouer al things that appertained to him,
23.odr_com: And when he had set ouer al things that appertained to him,
23.sabates_a: And when he had set over all things that appertained to him,
23.madueke_b: And when he had set over all things that appertained to him,

24.s_dismas: he taried alone: and behold a man wraſteled with him til morning.
24.odr_com: he taried alone: and behold a man wrasteled with him til morning.
24.sabates_a: he tarried alone: and behold a man wrestled with him till morning.
24.madueke_b: he tarried alone: and behold a man wrestled with him till morning.

25.s_dismas: Who when he ſaw that he could not ouercome him, he touched the ſinowe of his thighe, and forthwith it ſhranke.
25.odr_com: Who when he saw that he could not ouercome him, he touched the sinowe of his thighe, and forthwith it shranke.
25.sabates_a: Who when he saw that he could not overcome him, he touched the sinew of his thigh, and forthwith it shrank.
25.madueke_b: Who when he saw that he could not overcome him, he touched the sinew of his thigh, and forthwith it shrank.

26.s_dismas: And he ſaid to him: Let me goe for it is breake of day. He anſwered: I wil not let thee goe, vnleſſe thou bleſſe me.
26.odr_com: And he said to him: Let me goe for it is breake of day. He answered: I wil not let thee goe, vnlesse thou blesse me.
26.sabates_a: And he said to him: Let me go for it is break of day. He answered: I will not let thee go, unless thou bless me.
26.madueke_b: And he said to him: Let me go for it is break of day. He answered: I will not let thee go, unless thou bless me.

27.s_dismas: He therfore ſaid: What is thy name? He anſwered: Iacob.
27.odr_com: He therfore said: What is thy name? He answered: Iacob.
27.sabates_a: He therefore said: What is thy name? He answered: Jacob.
27.madueke_b: He therefore said: What is thy name? He answered: Jacob.

28.s_dismas: But he, no, thy name, quoth he, ſhal not be called Iacob, but Iſrael: for if thou haſt bene ſtrong againſt God, how much more shalt thou preuaile againſt men?
28.odr_com: But he, no, thy name, quoth he, shal not be called Iacob, but Israel: for if thou hast bene strong against God, how much more shalt thou preuaile against men?
28.sabates_a: But he, no, thy name, quoth he, shall not be called Jacob. But Israel: for if thou hast been strong against God, how much more shalt thou prevail against men?
28.madueke_b: But he, no, thy name, quoth he, shall not be called Jacob. But Israel: for if thou hast been strong against God, how much more shalt thou prevail against men?

29.s_dismas: Iacob asked him: Tel me by what name art thou called? He anſwered: Why doeſt thou aske my name? and bleſſed him in the ſame place.
29.odr_com: Iacob asked him: Tel me by what name art thou called? He answered: Why doest thou aske my name? and blessed him in the same place.
29.sabates_a: Jacob asked him: Tell me by what name art thou called? He answered: Why dost thou ask my name? and blessed him in the same place.
29.madueke_b: Jacob asked him: Tell me by what name art thou called? He answered: Why dost thou ask my name? and blessed him in the same place.

30.s_dismas: And Iacob called the name of the place Phanuel, ſaying: I haue ſene God face to face, and my ſoule was made ſafe.
30.odr_com: And Iacob called the name of the place Phanuel, saying: I haue sene God face to face, and my soule was made safe.
30.sabates_a: And Jacob called the name of the place Phanuel, saying: I have seen God face to face, and my soul was made safe.
30.madueke_b: And Jacob called the name of the place Phanuel, saying: I have seen God face to face, and my soul was made safe.

31.s_dismas: And immediatly the ſunne roſe to him, after that he was paſt Phanuel; but he halted on his foote.
31.odr_com: And immediatly the sunne rose to him, after that he was past Phanuel; but he halted on his foote.
31.sabates_a: And immediately the sun rose to him, after that he was past Phanuel; but he halted on his foot.
31.madueke_b: And immediately the sun rose to him, after that he was past Phanuel; but he halted on his foot.

32.s_dismas: For which cauſe the children of Iſrael eate not the ſinowe, that ſhrunke in Iacobs thighe, vnto this preſent day: becauſe he touched the ſinowe of his thighe, and it ſhrunke.
32.odr_com: For which cause the children of Israel eate not the sinowe, that shrunke in Iacobes thighe, vnto his present day: because he touched the sinowe of his thighe, and it shrunke.
32.sabates_a: For which cause the children of Israel eat not the sinew, that shrunk in Jacob's thigh, unto this present day: because he touched the sinew of his thigh, and it shrunk.
32.madueke_b: For which cause the children of Israel eat not the sinew, that shrunk in Jacob's thigh, unto this present day: because he touched the sinew of his thigh, and it shrunk.

janvier_by_verse.3: And he sent also messengers before him to Esau his brother into the land of Seir, into the country of Edom:
janvier_by_verse.4: and he commanded them, saying: Thus speak ye unto my lord Esau: This saith thy brother Jacob: I have sojourned, and have been with Laban until this present day.
janvier_by_verse.5: I have oxen, & asses, & sheep, & men servants: & women servants: & now I send a legacy to my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
janvier_by_verse.6: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying: We came to Esau thy brother, & behold he cometh with speed to meet thee with four hundred men.
